task:
Produce a comprehensive, truly useful report on the additions that should be present in the admin panel of the TMT application.

Scope: ONLY the admin panel — the routers under app/bot/routers/admin/ (menu, stats, users, channels, broadcast, notifications, backups, search, settings) and the data/services they directly depend on. Do NOT produce a whole-codebase quality assessment like the existing docs/quality-assessment.md (PR #12); narrow the lens specifically to identifying what the admin panel is missing.

Task: For each admin panel route, analyze what data/views, controls/actions, and integrations it should have but currently does not, by cross-referencing: (1) the underlying DB schema and domain models, (2) the core subsystems it interfaces with — TransferEngine (app/tg/transfer.py), JobManager (app/core/job_manager.py), BroadcastEngine (app/core/broadcast.py), notification system (app/core/notifications.py), user settings (app/core/settings.py) — (3) PRD.md requirements and RULES.md contracts, (4) existing design docs under docs/. Identify: missing data/views, missing controls/actions, missing subsystem integrations, missing validation/error handling, and any admin-panel-specific defects (e.g., missing owner_id scoping causing IDOR — see the whole-codebase report's item #4 in repositories.py:898,918,928). Specifically call out the empty backups.py stub and any other routes that are scaffolding-only.

Output: Write a clean markdown report to docs/admin-panel-gaps.md. Inspection-only — do NOT modify any application code. Format with per-route sections, a prioritized 'missing additions' list, and line-precise source references. Be thorough and concrete — cite specific files and line numbers.

findings.title: Report states menu welcome banner renders 'four live counters' (code has three)
findings.detail: Line 60 says render_admin_menu (texts.py:101-111) renders 'four live counters', but render_admin_menu(user_count, jobs_count, completed_count) at texts.py:101 is called with exactly three args (populated by menu.py:21-24) and renders three counters (users, total jobs, completed). This contradicts the report's own section 1 line 65, which lists three. Fix: change 'four' to 'three'.

findings.title: Prioritized table item #4 misattributes texts.py:648 to notifications
findings.detail: Item #4 (notifications -> wire render_notification_card) cites 'texts.py:648,738'. texts.py:648 is render_bcast_progress (a broadcast renderer, dead code referenced only by a comment at broadcast.py:206), not a notifications symbol. render_notification_card is at texts.py:738. The 648 is a stray reference copied from item #11 (broadcast). Fix: drop 648 from item #4; keep 738.
